concept.title: A Bad Day Was Never the Whole Truth
concept.human_truth: Love can remain true on a day when two tired people genuinely dislike each other and make the room harder to live in.
concept.emotional_arc: automatic care under irritation -> self-recognition -> cramped mutual obstruction -> hurt amplified into consequence -> equal repair without denied anger -> the wider relationship survives the frame
concept.format_shell: Six-slide causal single-evening sequence: Narrow Orbit.
concept.public_send_reason: Send this to the person who knows that one ugly mood never gets to narrate the whole relationship.

visual_setup: NARROW ORBIT. A single rainy evening in one genuinely small rented room, directed as a causal short film rather than six couple posters. The room contains a narrow aisle, one small work table, a low divan or floor mattress, one intact table lamp, one shared extension board, an open wardrobe door, one chair, two work bags, a rain-damp umbrella and an untouched simple meal. Only the lamp, extension board, chair and wardrobe door change state; everything else is restrained lived biography. Progress two visual variables: body distance moves from compressed avoidance to opposing diagonals to maximum pull to coordinated proximity; motivated light moves from mixed rainy blue plus warm practical light to accidental blackout blue to one restored warm pool. Line grammar moves from diagonals and a taut cord toward slack cable and stable horizontal framing. Exactly Aachu and Zuv, no background people, portraits that read as people, reflections, silhouettes, duplicate bodies or narrative extras. One continuous charcoal-and-ivory evening wardrobe from the selected identity photographs. Anger is weary and reciprocal, never contemptuous, threatening or physically intimidating. No shouting caricature, pointing, broken object, looming, rescue hierarchy, split-screen, comic sound marks, floating hearts, storm symbols, apology bouquet, hug, kiss or generic romance pose. Neutral warm ivory paper, fine graphite and ink, restrained indigo/denim watercolor, charcoal wardrobe, terracotta accents only inside the room and soft practical lamp light; the paper itself never turns yellow or sepia. Clean upper-middle ivory negative space for exact integrated copy and tiny top-right @a.storyof.two on every slide.
identity_prompt_override: Attach exactly these current identity anchors to every generation call: together-18.jpg for both close faces and their charcoal-grey/charcoal-black evening wardrobe; reel-jaldi.jpg for Aachu's unobscured oval face, expressive dark eyes, brows, nose, natural skin and long dark hair; portrait-07.jpg for Zuv's restrained expression, dark eyes, thick dark hair, beard, jaw and adult body proportions; together-16.jpg for full-body near-equal couple scale and real two-inch height relationship only, never for its outdoor wardrobe or Aachu's tinted glasses. Aachu is 5 feet 6 inches and Zuv is 5 feet 8 inches, exactly two inches apart when standing at the same depth. Aachu wears the charcoal-grey blazer over an ivory top and graphite trousers anchored in together-18; Zuv wears the charcoal-black shirt and dark trousers anchored in together-18. Their clothes may loosen and crease naturally over the evening but do not change. Warm medium-brown South Asian skin, natural adult proportions. No fair skin, no child scale, no large height gap, no generic stock-couple faces, no clean-shaven or straight-haired Zuv, no short-haired Aachu, no tinted glasses, no outdoor waterfall wardrobe, no pregnancy inference from alternate references.

slides.copy:
I loved you.
I just didn’t like your face that day.
slides.emotion: tired irritation with care still operating underneath
slides.visual: CHEST-HEIGHT COMPRESSED DOORWAY MEDIUM TWO-SHOT, 50MM FEEL. Exactly Aachu and Zuv squeeze past each other in the room's single narrow aisle after coming in from rain, torsos angled in opposite directions and irritated faces turned away. Aachu uses her clearly visible right hand to place Zuv's phone onto the shared charger without looking at him; her left hand stays fully inside her trouser pocket. At the same instant Zuv uses his clearly visible left hand to catch Aachu's slipping water glass upright on the table edge; his right hand remains fully behind his own body. Their reciprocal reflexes protect each other's belongings even while neither wants eye contact. Keep both readable faces large, human and weary rather than cruel. The warm lamp glows behind them against cool rainy-window ambience, but neutral ivory paper remains visible around the scene. Exactly two people, exactly two visible active hands, no reflection, no extra hand, no background figure. Reserve the upper-middle paper field for exact copy.
slides.pose: Same-depth compressed standing two-shot, exact two-inch height difference. Bodies pass in opposite directions without collision; Aachu owns one visible right hand at the charger and Zuv owns one visible left hand at the glass. Their other hands are fully hidden or pocketed.
slides.wardrobe: Locked together-18 charcoal-and-ivory evening wardrobe, slightly rain-damp at shoulders and hems.
slides.props: one phone, one shared charger and extension board, one water glass, one intact glowing table lamp
slides.continuity_lock: The same tiny room, wardrobe, phone charger, extension board and lamp continue. The lamp is upright and the cord is slack here.
slides.cta_intent: The body language says dislike; the two simultaneous care reflexes say love before the viewer finishes the line.

slides.emotion: a flash of embarrassed self-awareness inside the bad mood
slides.visual: INTIMATE 85MM SIDE-PROFILE CLOSE-UP OF AACHU ALONE beside the open wardrobe, no mirror and no reflection. She has just pulled her hair tie too tight with one clearly attached right hand; the tension makes her own eyebrows pinch, nose wrinkle and mouth form an equally impossible expression. She catches herself mid-gesture and loosens the tie a fraction, her eyes dropping with a tiny private wince at her own contribution. Her left hand remains fully outside the crop. Zuv is absent. The warm lamp grazes the real face from one side while cool window light defines the other. One face, one visible hand, one hair tie; no doubled face, phone UI, mirror, text on objects or extra person. Reserve generous clean ivory above and left for exact copy.
slides.pose: Tight single-person side profile. Aachu's right upper arm, forearm, wrist and hand form one continuous line to the hair tie; left hand out of frame. Expression remains flattering, recognizable and tired, not grotesque.
slides.wardrobe: Same charcoal-grey blazer, ivory top and long dark hair from slide 1; blazer shoulder still lightly rain-damp.
slides.props: one plain dark hair tie, open wardrobe edge soft in background
slides.continuity_lock: This is seconds after slide 1. The same lamp remains lit and the extension cord remains slack off-frame.
slides.cta_intent: The self-jab prevents blame and lets the viewer recognize her own unhelpful face without a literal mirror gimmick.

slides.copy:
Two bad moods.
One very small room.
slides.visual: TRUE CEILING-CORNER EXTREME OVERHEAD WIDE, 24MM FEEL. Exactly Aachu and Zuv create the blockage at the same time in the tiny room: Aachu opens the wardrobe door into the only aisle while Zuv rolls the single work chair backward into that same path. Both stop in equal surprise and look across the remaining hand-span of floor at each other, neither innocent and neither looming. The overhead view clearly proves the room's geography: low divan on one side, small work table on the other, narrow aisle between, rain-dark window, two work bags, damp umbrella near the door, untouched simple meal, upright glowing lamp and slack extension cord. Keep objects sparse and readable. Each person has both hands either fixed to their own action or hidden: Aachu's right hand owns the wardrobe handle, left arm stays behind the door; Zuv's right hand rests on the chair back, left hand stays on his own thigh. Exactly two people, no mirror, portrait, shadow-person or background figure. Upper-center neutral ivory paper remains clear for text.
slides.pose: Overhead diagonal two-person blockage. Aachu stands at wardrobe side; Zuv sits or half-rises at chair side. Every body edge stays separate from furniture and door planes.
slides.wardrobe: Same locked continuous evening wardrobe, now drying naturally.
slides.props: one wardrobe door, one work chair, low divan, small table, lamp, shared extension board, two work bags, damp umbrella, untouched meal
slides.continuity_lock: Same room geography as slide 1 is finally revealed. The lamp stays upright and the cord remains slack before the escalation.
slides.cta_intent: The room itself becomes the joke and makes the line publicly recognizable without turning either partner into the problem.

slides.copy: We made each other’s hurt louder.
slides.emotion: separate tiredness combining into one sharper hurt
slides.visual: LOW TABLE-LEVEL OBSTRUCTED CLOSE VIEW, 35MM FEEL, THE HIGHEST-RISK HERO RECEIPT. The shared extension board is large and sharp in the lower foreground. Exactly Aachu and Zuv reach for it from opposite sides at the same instant: Aachu's clearly attached left hand pulls the charger end toward herself while Zuv's clearly attached right hand pulls the lamp plug end toward himself. Their simultaneous pull makes the extension board slide across the table, turns the cord taut and tips the intact lamp only partway onto its padded side; the lamp is never smashed. A small key bowl rattles but nothing breaks. Behind the consequence, both recognizable faces recoil with hurt rather than rage, mouths closed after realizing the effect. Their free hands are fully out of frame. The untouched meal and obstructing chair stay softly visible as continuity evidence. Exactly two people, exactly two visible hands, one extension board, one intact tipping lamp, no shouting, pointing, flying debris, extra limbs or fire. Leave a clean upper-left ivory text zone.
slides.pose: Both lean from their own side without crossing bodies. Aachu's left shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist-to-hand line reaches one cable end; Zuv's right shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist-to-hand line reaches the other. Faces stay separate from lamp, table and cord.
slides.wardrobe: Same charcoal-and-ivory wardrobe with natural creases from the cramped movement.
slides.props: one shared extension board, two separate plug ends, one intact table lamp tipping safely, one small key bowl, untouched meal
slides.continuity_lock: Slack cord becomes taut; upright warm lamp is pulled off balance and its plug is about to release. No object breaks.
slides.cta_intent: Mutual action creates a visible consequence, turning a familiar relationship line into one ownable incident.

slides.copy:
The anger was real.
So was the love.
slides.role: Turn / equal repair without erased anger
slides.emotion: anger still present while teamwork returns by reflex
slides.visual: INTIMATE FLOOR-HEIGHT THREE-QUARTER CLOSE INSERT, 85MM FEEL, MOMENTS AFTER THE PLUG COMES FREE. The room sits in cool rainy blue near-darkness while the intact lamp rests safely on its padded side. Both are still visibly angry: jaws set, breathing not yet softened, no smile or apology pose. They nevertheless repair the same accident together. Zuv's clearly attached right hand lifts the lamp by its solid base; his left hand stays flat on his own thigh and separate from the lamp. Aachu's clearly attached left hand pushes the lamp plug fully back into the extension board; her right hand braces openly on the floor beside her own knee. All four hands are traceable and perform only one compatible action each. Their eyes meet only as the warm practical light returns between them, forming a restrained pool inside the scene without tinting the neutral ivory paper. Exactly two people, no hug, rescue, forehead touch, heart glow, extra body, reflection, fire, broken object or magical light. Reserve the upper-middle paper for exact copy and keep faces large enough for identity review.
slides.pose: Both kneel at the same depth with equal agency and believable body separation from the floor, table and lamp. Zuv lifts only the base; Aachu plugs in only the cord. Exact two-inch height relationship remains plausible even while kneeling.
slides.wardrobe: Same continuous charcoal-and-ivory wardrobe, softly creased; no outfit or jewelry changes.
slides.props: one intact lamp, one shared extension board, one now-slack cord, warm light returning
slides.continuity_lock: The taut cord from slide 4 releases into a blackout, then becomes slack only after both restore the lamp. Anger remains visible; the first changed fact is coordinated action, not sweetness.
slides.cta_intent: The smallest decisive receipt proves that love and anger coexist without assigning a rescuer.

slides.emotion: ordinary togetherness after conflict, unresolved but intact
slides.visual: STABLE HORIZONTAL DOORWAY WIDE REPRISE, 40MM FEEL, PULLED FARTHER BACK THAN SLIDE 1. The same imperfect room remains honest: chair still slightly displaced, wardrobe now closed, two work bags and damp umbrella by the door, rain at the window, key bowl settled, extension cord slack and the repaired lamp upright in one calm warm pool. Exactly Aachu and Zuv sit shoulder-to-shoulder on the floor within that light, quietly sharing the simple meal left untouched in slides 3 and 4. Neither is theatrically cheerful. Aachu uses her right hand to offer the final piece of food across the small space; Zuv receives it with his left hand, while both outside hands rest visibly on their own knees. Their eyes meet with tired recognition, not a grin. The wider frame contains both the evening's disorder and the surviving ordinary rhythm. Exactly two people, four traceable hands, no hug, kiss, floating heart, sunrise, cleaned-up fantasy room, reflection, portrait, silhouette or background actor. Large neutral ivory upper field for exact copy; tiny top-right brandmark.
slides.pose: Same-depth seated two-shot, shoulders touch lightly, no embrace. Aachu's right hand offers; Zuv's left hand receives; outside hands rest separately on their own knees.
slides.wardrobe: Same charcoal-and-ivory evening wardrobe, dry enough to show tactile folds and the same face/body anchors.
slides.props: repaired lamp, slack extension cord, simple shared meal, displaced chair, closed wardrobe, two work bags, damp umbrella, key bowl
slides.continuity_lock: Return to slide 1 doorway geography, now wider. The bad day remains visible in the room; the relationship is shown by the ordinary rhythm that continues inside it.
slides.cta_intent: The camera literally reveals a wider truth than the conflict close-ups and lands the send/save thesis without sentimental completion.

copy.caption_recommended:
Some days, love is not the absence of anger.

It is the quiet fact that one difficult day does not get to narrate the whole relationship.

We were both tired. We both made it worse. And somewhere inside all that noise, we still reached for the same light.

A bad day was never the whole truth about us. 🤍
copy.caption_alt: We were angry. We were still us. Both things were true.
